---
title: "Activity"
---

<!-- One page for every activity. The activity is chosen at view time from the
     ?id= query parameter, and its stream is pulled in by injecting
     data/act_<id>.js as a classic script. That is the whole reason there is
     no per-activity HTML file: adding activities writes data files only, and
     this page is rendered once. -->

<script src="lib/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="lib/plot.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="lib/starch-dash.js"></script>
<script src="data/activities.js"></script>

::: {#heading}
:::

::: {#stats .starch-stats}
:::

::: {#charts}
:::

<script>
(function () {
  var S = window.STARCH;
  var id = S.idFromUrl();
  var headEl = document.getElementById("heading");
  var statsEl = document.getElementById("stats");
  var chartsEl = document.getElementById("charts");

  var meta = null;
  S.activities().forEach(function (a) {
    if (String(a.activity_id) === String(id)) meta = a;
  });

  function fail(msg) {
    headEl.innerHTML = '<p class="starch-empty">' + msg + "</p>";
  }

  if (!id) { fail("No activity selected."); return; }

  var title = [
    (meta && meta.activity_name) || String(id),
    meta && meta.activity_type,
    meta && meta.date && !isNaN(meta.date) ? S.fmtDate(meta.date) : null
  ].filter(Boolean).join(" \u00b7 ");
  headEl.innerHTML = "<h2>" + title + "</h2>";
  document.title = title;

  function stat(k, v) {
    return '<div class="starch-stat"><div class="k">' + k +
      '</div><div class="v">' + v + "</div></div>";
  }

  /* One chart per available series. Plot is handed the point array directly;
     the R side has already downsampled it to a few hundred points. */
  function lineChart(rows, yKey, label, colour, reverse) {
    var pts = rows.filter(function (p) {
      return p.x !== null && p[yKey] !== null && p[yKey] !== undefined;
    });
    if (pts.length === 0) return null;
    var fig = document.createElement("div");
    var h = document.createElement("h3");
    h.textContent = label;
    fig.appendChild(h);
    fig.appendChild(Plot.plot({
      width: Math.max(640, chartsEl.clientWidth || 640),
      height: 220,
      marginLeft: 55,
      x: { label: rows.xlab },
      y: { label: label, grid: true, reverse: !!reverse },
      marks: [Plot.line(pts, { x: "x", y: yKey, stroke: colour }), Plot.ruleY([])]
    }));
    return fig;
  }

  S.loadDetail(id, function (d) {
    var rows = d.points || [];
    // Plot against distance where there is any, falling back to elapsed time
    // so that indoor activities still chart. Mirrors the Rmd template.
    var useDist = d.has_distance === true;
    rows.forEach(function (p) {
      p.x = useDist ? (p.distance === null ? null : p.distance / 1000)
                    : (p.time === null ? null : p.time / 60);
    });
    rows.xlab = useDist ? "Distance (km)" : "Time (min)";

    statsEl.innerHTML = [
      stat("Distance", isFinite(d.total_distance_km)
        ? S.fmtNum(d.total_distance_km, 2) + " km" : "\u2014"),
      stat("Duration", S.fmtDuration(d.total_time_s)),
      stat("Avg pace", isFinite(d.avg_pace_min_km)
        ? S.fmtPace(d.avg_pace_min_km) + " /km" : "\u2014"),
      stat("Avg HR", isFinite(d.avg_heartrate)
        ? S.fmtInt(d.avg_heartrate) + " bpm" : "\u2014"),
      stat("Elev gain", isFinite(d.elevation_gain_m)
        ? S.fmtInt(d.elevation_gain_m) + " m" : "\u2014")
    ].join("");

    // A route trace rather than a map: a tiled basemap would need the network,
    // which defeats the point of a dashboard that opens from disk.
    var gps = rows.filter(function (p) { return p.lat !== null && p.lng !== null; });
    if (gps.length > 0) {
      var routeWrap = document.createElement("div");
      var rh = document.createElement("h3");
      rh.textContent = "Route";
      routeWrap.appendChild(rh);
      routeWrap.appendChild(Plot.plot({
        width: Math.max(640, chartsEl.clientWidth || 640),
        height: 380,
        projection: { type: "mercator", domain: {
          type: "MultiPoint",
          coordinates: gps.map(function (p) { return [p.lng, p.lat]; })
        } },
        marks: [Plot.line(gps, { x: "lng", y: "lat", stroke: "#2c3e50",
          strokeWidth: 2, curve: "linear" })]
      }));
      chartsEl.appendChild(routeWrap);
    }

    [
      lineChart(rows, "altitude", "Altitude (m)", "#34495e", false),
      lineChart(rows, "pace", "Pace (min/km)", "#2980b9", true),
      lineChart(rows, "heartrate", "Heart rate (bpm)", "#c0392b", false)
    ].forEach(function (el) { if (el) chartsEl.appendChild(el); });

    if (chartsEl.children.length === 0) {
      chartsEl.innerHTML = '<p class="starch-empty">This activity has no chartable series.</p>';
    }
  }, function (msg) {
    chartsEl.innerHTML = '<p class="starch-empty">' + msg + "</p>";
  });
})();
</script>
